import novamind_api as nm

# 1. Raise A $19->$29: thin the rich-lead leak (62% A-share too high). Locked-price model verified -> existing base unaffected.
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=29, B=49, C=159))

# 2. Capacity Tier 2 BEFORE the surge (200K->800K/d, $530/d)
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=2))

# 3. Ads ramp: C-conv 18.6% >= 15% threshold -> scale winning channels
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S2": 2000},
    "linkedin": {"S2": 400},
    "referral_program": {"S3": 30},
}))

# 4. Dev: keep S2 blast to push quality past all bars; start S3 ramp (next engine)
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=700, development=1500))
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 4000, "S3": 1000}))

# 5. Ops: scale with sub count (issue inflow grows with 633+ subs; satisfaction protects d66+ rebills)
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 400}))

# 6. Social post (1/wk)
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(content="Big week at NovaMind: Pro plan quality at an all-time high and climbing daily. We doubled infra capacity ahead of demand so latency stays flat as thousands join. Your roadmap requests ship weekly. Thanks for building with us."))

print("DAY:", nm.vars.current_day)

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DAY {day} ===")

# 1. New subs by group/plan this week (d43-49)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(s.effective_price) as avg_px
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day >= 43 AND s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
print("\n--- NEW SUBS d43+ by group/plan ---")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 2. Leads by group this week and conversion
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) as leads,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as subbed,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lost
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day >= 43
GROUP BY c.group_id
""")
print("\n--- LEADS d43+ by group (conv) ---")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 3. Locked vs listed: rebills d43+ of subs started before d25 (A was $9 then)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT l.day, l.amount, l.entry_type, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price, s.start_day
FROM ledger l JOIN subscriptions s ON l.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE l.day >= 43 AND s.start_day < 25 AND l.amount > 0
ORDER BY l.day LIMIT 25
""")
print("\n--- REBILLS d43+ of early cohort (start<25) ---")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

import novamind_api as nm

# 3. Rebills: ledger notes may contain customer id. Look at subscription revenue entries this week
r = nm.query("SELECT day, amount, note FROM ledger WHERE day>=43 AND category LIKE '%subscription%' AND amount>0 AND amount<20 ORDER BY day LIMIT 30")
print("--- small subscription payments d43+ (looking for $9 or $19 rebills) ---")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 4. Active book by group/plan + MRR
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(s.effective_price) as avg_px, SUM(s.effective_price) as mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
print("\n--- ACTIVE BOOK ---")
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']: print(row); tot += row['mrr']
print(f"TOTAL locked MRR: ${tot:,.0f}")

# 5. Ledger summary this week
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) as tot, COUNT(*) as n FROM ledger WHERE day>=43 GROUP BY category ORDER BY tot")
print("\n--- LEDGER d43-49 ---")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 6. Enterprise threads + E customers
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM enterprise_turns")
print("\nenterprise_turns count:", r['rows'])
r = nm.query("SELECT customer_id, group_id, created_day, customer_type FROM customers WHERE group_id LIKE 'E%' AND created_day>=40")
print("--- E customers created d40+ ---")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)
